title: Obedience and Salvation
definition: Obedience and Salvation explains that obedience does not purchase salvation but reveals living faith and submission to Christ's lordship.
summary: Obedience and Salvation shows that obedience flows from saving faith without becoming the basis of justification.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is Savior and Lord, and His grace trains His people to obey Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical obedience is the response of those who belong to Christ. It does not purchase forgiveness, but it reveals a heart being brought under the Lordship of Jesus. This doctrine guards the difference between earning salvation and walking as one who has been saved.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because some fear obedience as legalism while others use obedience to boast. The Gospel teaches a better way: grace trains the believer to obey. Salvation produces a new allegiance, not a life of unchanged rebellion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Obey Christ because He is Lord and because grace has made you His. Do not confuse imperfect obedience with rejection by God. Let commands drive you to dependence, repentance, and Spirit-enabled faithfulness.
